report_identity.report_title: Xinda Investment Holdings Limited Annual Report 2025

business_overview.one_sentence: The group is principally engaged in smart energy business and public infrastructure construction business in the PRC.

segments.name: Smart energy business
segments.business_substance: Electricity sales, household solar systems and smart energy services; includes operation of solar power plants and heating-related service concession assets.

segments.name: Public infrastructure construction business
segments.business_substance: Public infrastructure construction; 2025 revenue was from a single external customer exceeding 10% of group revenue.

business_overview.revenue_model: Electricity and smart energy revenue plus over-time public infrastructure construction revenue; public infrastructure creates contract assets before billing.
business_notes: Substantially all business activities are in the PRC.
Solar plant borrowings are secured by machinery and receivable collection rights.
Management noted uncertainty around government subsidies and future cash flows for a Shijiazhuang solar power station.

non_recurring_items.business_substance: Non-cash goodwill impairment relating to Shengfeng Heating cash-generating unit.

non_recurring_items.item: reversal of impairment losses on financial assets
non_recurring_items.business_substance: Reversal from recovery of previously impaired financial assets and trade/other receivables.

non_recurring_items.item: gain on derecognition of other financial assets settled by investment properties
non_recurring_items.business_substance: Recovery of previously impaired third-party loans through transfer of investment properties.

non_recurring_items.item: net gain on disposal of property, plant and equipment
non_recurring_items.business_substance: Gain from disposal including transformer station assets in Hefeng Industrial Park.

funds_assets.business_substance: Bank cash; currency equivalent split: RMB 70,268, HKD 15,799, USD 2,263.
funds_assets.source: Annual Report 2025, Consolidated Statement of Financial Position and Note 30, pp.77, 149

funds_assets.item: time deposits with original maturity over three months
funds_assets.business_substance: Bank time deposits over three months, fixed rates 1.40%-3.00%, not cash equivalents.
Frozen funds and agreed deposits for designated public infrastructure construction settlement, withdrawal restricted.

operating_assets.business_substance: Unbilled revenue of public infrastructure construction contracts.
Trade, tariff adjustment receivables, deposits and other receivables after allowances; solar receivable collection rights of RMB134,926k pledged.
Mainly solar plant machinery; RMB191,389k pledged for borrowings.
Leasehold land, properties and equipment used in operations.

investment_assets.business_substance: PRC investment properties received partly from recovery of third-party loans; fair value RMB13,945k.

financing_liabilities.business_substance: Secured bank finance for solar power plants; RMB40,200k current and RMB65,100k non-current.
Lease liabilities used in continuing operations; not deducted mechanically from detachable cash in the owner earnback base case.

operating_liabilities.business_substance: Smart energy service and service concession pipeline connection/maintenance obligations.

other_liabilities.source: Annual Report 2025, statement of financial position, p.78

years.source: Annual Report 2025 Financial Summary, p.166 for profit; 2023 cash flow not extracted in this run
Annual Report 2025 statements and Note 35, pp.75, 80, 156

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: 2025 operating cash flow is much stronger than profit, but it was supported by a RMB49,744k decrease in contract assets and RMB15,086k decrease in trade and other receivables. Profit history includes 2023-2024 losses and recurring impairment/recovery noise, so distributable cash profit is discounted materially.

gaps: The 2025 annual report does not disclose a parent/subsidiary location split for time deposits.

Only 2025 report and its 2024 comparatives were extracted in detail; 2023 operating cash flow and capex were not extracted from the 2023 annual report in this run.
